mapper.select: SELECT member_id, visa_type, entry_date, expected_return_date, updated_at FROM stay_info WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stay_info (member_id, entry_date, expected_return_date) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{entryDate}, #{expectedReturnDate}) AS newrow ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE entry_date = newrow.entry_date, expected_return_date = newrow.expected_return_date
